summary: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based SPAC listed on Nasdaq (WTG/WTGUU), filed an 8-K disclosing a $184,635 unsecured promissory note issued September 28, 2026 to sponsor MACRO DREAM Holdings Limited, with proceeds deposited into the trust account to fund an extension of the deadline to complete its initial business combination. The note bears no interest, matures at the earlier of deal close or required liquidation, is forgiven absent a combination, and is convertible into units at $10.00; the sponsor waived trust claims. Watch extension runway, redemption levels, and conversion overhang.
